title: CallbackQuery
description:
`GET /auth/callback` query: the provider's redirect back to the common callback. It carries no tenant selector.

`code` and `state` are required. The RFC 9207 `iss` response parameter is retained when present so the callback can bind the response to the issuer the login state recorded before any token-endpoint request. Other provider response parameters (Keycloak's `session_state`) are ignored, as RFC 6749 §4.1.2 requires of the client.

code.description: Authorization code from the identity provider callback.

iss.description: RFC 9207 authorization-response issuer identifier, when the provider sends one. It must equal the login's recorded issuer exactly.

state.description: Opaque login state generated by Wyrd.

SecretBearer.description: Opaque secret. Redacted in logs and audit payloads.
